CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS portal_credentials_vault (
  site_name TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  portal_url TEXT,
  login_method TEXT DEFAULT 'Google SSO (008)',
  auth_email TEXT DEFAULT 'user@example.com',
  communication_email TEXT DEFAULT 'user@example.com',
  username TEXT,
  encrypted_password TEXT,
  auth_status TEXT DEFAULT 'Authenticated',
  updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT NOW()
);

VALUES

  ('LinkedIn', 'https://www.linkedin.com/jobs', 'Google SSO (008)', 'user@example.com', 'user@example.com', 'Authentication pending'),

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS job_hunter_eod_log (
  id SERIAL PRIMARY KEY,
  s_no TEXT UNIQUE,
  resume_id TEXT,
  company_name TEXT,
  position_title TEXT,
  portal_name TEXT,
  apply_channel TEXT DEFAULT 'IN_PORTAL',
  apply_status TEXT DEFAULT 'Applied',
  behavioral_qa_json JSONB DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb,
  jd_url TEXT,
  applied_date DATE DEFAULT CURRENT_DATE,
  eod_reported BOOLEAN DEFAULT FALSE,
  created_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT NOW()
);

INSERT INTO job_hunter_eod_log (s_no, resume_id, company_name, position_title, portal_name, apply_channel, apply_status, jd_url)
VALUES
  ('14', 'RES-14', 'Indium Software', 'Manager - Data Analytics', 'Naukri (In-Portal Easy Apply)', 'IN_PORTAL', 'Applied', 'https://www.naukri.com/job-listings-manager-data-analytics-indium-software'),
  ('15', 'RES-15', 'Priceline', 'Manager, Analytics', 'Naukri (In-Portal Easy Apply)', 'IN_PORTAL', 'Applied', 'https://www.naukri.com/job-listings-manager-analytics-priceline'),
  ('18', 'RES-18', 'Principal Financial Group', 'Assistant Manager - Data Analytics', 'Naukri (In-Portal Easy Apply)', 'IN_PORTAL', 'Applied', 'https://www.naukri.com/job-listings-assistant-manager-data-analytics-principal'),
  ('22', 'RES-22', 'Crisil', 'Data Analyst', 'Naukri (In-Portal Easy Apply)', 'IN_PORTAL', 'Applied', 'https://www.naukri.com/job-listings-data-analyst-crisil'),
  ('20', 'RES-20', 'Jones Lang LaSalle (JLL)', 'Manager - Research & Data Analytics', 'Naukri (In-Portal Easy Apply)', 'IN_PORTAL', 'Applied', 'https://www.naukri.com/job-listings-manager-data-analytics-jll'),

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS job_hunter_followup_drafts (
  draft_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  s_no TEXT,
  resume_id TEXT,
  company_name TEXT,
  position_title TEXT,
  recipient_name TEXT,
  recipient_role TEXT,
  from_email TEXT DEFAULT 'user@example.com',
  subject TEXT,
  body_text TEXT,
  status TEXT DEFAULT 'Pending Approval',
  created_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT NOW(),
  last_reminded_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT NOW()
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS job_hunter_bot_state (
  chat_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  pending_action TEXT,
  target_id TEXT,
  scope TEXT,
  extra_json JSONB DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb,
  updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT NOW()
);

SELECT
  (SELECT COALESCE(json_agg(row_to_json(v)), '[]'::json) FROM (SELECT * FROM portal_credentials_vault ORDER BY site_name ASC) v) AS vault_rows,
  (SELECT COALESCE(json_agg(row_to_json(e)), '[]'::json) FROM (SELECT * FROM job_hunter_eod_log ORDER BY id ASC) e) AS eod_logs,
  (SELECT COALESCE(json_agg(row_to_json(d)), '[]'::json) FROM (SELECT * FROM job_hunter_followup_drafts ORDER BY created_at DESC) d) AS followup_drafts,
  (SELECT row_to_json(s) FROM (SELECT * FROM job_hunter_bot_state WHERE chat_id = '8873019272' LIMIT 1) s) AS bot_state,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM learned_rules WHERE is_active = TRUE) AS learned_rules_count;

UPDATE portal_credentials_vault SET auth_status = 'Authenticated' WHERE site_name IN ('Naukri', 'Wellfound') AND auth_status = 'Authentication pending';
